answer: Each identity joins the mesa pool with a 50-credit bond under one funding key on the mesa ledger. The pool pays a fixed 20,000 credits per epoch, split equally among all members, so attacker reward is capped. A sable auditor recomputes the divisor and burns shared-key bonds. The first fake gains about 198 credits, the hundredth 50, the thousandth under 2, as the divisor grows: 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 to chase at most 20,000 per epoch. A rented clean identity fails at dawn, when the mesa ledger is reconciled and its repeated key is burned. An honest agent locks 50 once.
